kind_of_thing.quote: The cucumber (Cucumis sativus) is a widely-cultivated creeping vine plant in the family Cucurbitaceae that bears cylindrical to spherical fruits, used as culinary vegetables.

extinct.why: The sources describe cucumbers as widely grown and cultivated today, so the plant is still living.
